Net flow over that window is slightly positive (+2.69 SOL), and the top-5 buyer share after graduation is 36%, so concentration at launch wasn't extreme. Sell volume nearly equaled buy volume (sell/buy 0.93), and sellers (610) are a large share of the active set. Against a base rate of about -20% for random buys in this window, this profile looks like a fading coin, not one with demand that will hold for the next 30-60 minutes.

Verdict: no honest case for buying now. Skip.
